My Process

  1. Discover

    We discuss your product, users, business goals, challenges, timeline, and definition of success.

  2. Proposal and Scope of Work

    Based on our discussion, I'll create a detailed Scope of Work (SOW)
    outlining deliverables, timelines, and pricing.

  3. Kickoff and Project Execution

    Once you approve the project plan and make the Initial deposit, I’ll begin the work and keep you updated at each key stage.

  4. Collaboration and Iterations (Validate)

    I’ll keep you involved in the process, share the designs and wireframes with you at key stages, collect your feedback, and test the ideas to ensure the final design meets your needs.

  5. Delivery & Post support

    You receive organised final files, interactive prototypes, design documentation, assets, and developer-ready specifications.with thorough documentation. I can collaborate during implementation, review the final build, or continue supporting your product and brand after launch.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the difference between Product Design and UI/UX Design?

Product design connects strategy, research, features, and the complete product experience. UI/UX design focuses on the structure, usability, and interface of a website or application.

How do I know which service is right for me?

Share what you are building and the challenge you need to solve. We can use a discovery conversation to define the right scope.

Can you design a product from an idea?

Yes. Product discovery and complete product design cover the journey from an early idea to a developer-ready experience.

How does payment work?

Payment terms and the initial deposit are agreed in the project proposal before work begins.

I have a limited budget—can I still work with you?

A focused scope can address your most important design priorities. Get in touch to discuss your goals and budget.

Why does UX cost this much? Can’t I get it cheaper elsewhere?

The scope includes research, structure, interaction design, and validation alongside the visual design. Each proposal reflects the work needed for your project.

Can you redesign my existing application or website?

Yes. The UI/UX Revamp service covers audits, user flows, navigation, interface redesign, and usability validation.

Can you create my brand and digital product together?

Yes. Brand identity and digital product design can be scoped together to create a consistent experience.

Why should I hire you over using AI myself?

The work combines research, product judgment, usability, and your business context, with collaboration throughout the process.

Do you use AI in your workflow?

AI can support exploration and the design workflow. Research, usability, business objectives, and brand direction guide the decisions.

Do you work with international clients?

Projects can be discussed remotely. Get in touch with your location, timeline, and collaboration needs.

Wait... how do I know if I even need UX help?

If people struggle to navigate, find information, or complete important actions, a UX review can help identify the friction.
